items.title: ISRO launches NVS-03 navigation satellite
items.text: ISRO successfully launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard the GSLV-F18. The satellite is part of the NavIC navigation system.

items.title: Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as Chief of the Air Staff
items.text: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit assumed charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A. P. Singh.

items.title: Government forms banking reform committee
items.text: The Government of India constituted a High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat to recommend banking-sector reforms.

items.title: UPI enabled for selected overseas online bookings
items.text: UPI acceptance has been enabled for online bookings at At the Top, Burj Khalifa and Resorts World Sentosa.

items.title: Manisha Bhanwala wins historic wrestling world title
items.text: Manisha Bhanwala became the first Indian woman to win gold at the Senior World Wrestling Championships.
